card.name: Digits inside round numbers and prices
card.fires_on: Fires on a digit (often 0) or separator partway through a number, especially round figures like 50, 100 or $50, and on 'dollar' in 'fifty-dollar' or 'hundred dollar' bill.

modes.label: Zero in round numbers
modes.description: The last or middle digit of a rounded amount, price or distance.

modes.label: Dollar after a number word
modes.description: The word dollar following a spelled-out number when naming a bill.

modes.label: Separators in number tables
modes.description: A decimal point or space inside numbers in tabular data.

card.writes: It promotes words for amounts and portions such as Lump, Euros, Sizes and Portions, so it adds a sense of quantity or currency.
card.plain: It activates in the middle of a number, such as the zero in a round price or amount.
